About ClearMax

ClearMax Auto Solutions was founded with a simple mission: to deliver exceptional automotive care with quality, reliability, and attention to detail.

For over a decade, we have proudly served dealerships and customers in Texas and across the US, providing professional automotive care solutions. We take pride in protecting every vehicle and building long-lasting relationships through service our customers can trust.

From the first inspection to the final walk-around, every vehicle that comes through our doors receives the same precision and care. We work with individual vehicle owners who want their car protected and looking its best, and with dealerships that need a dependable partner for consistent, professional results across their inventory.

  • Attention to every detail
  • Quality workmanship
  • Customer-focused service
  • Solutions for dealerships
  • Professional-grade products and tools
  • Long-term relationships built on trust
Quality

01 · Window Tint

Nano Ceramic Window Tint

Lifetime warranty

Our nano ceramic window tint is engineered to keep your vehicle cooler, more private and better protected, without sacrificing visibility or a clean, factory-quality look.

Unlike dyed or metallic films, nano ceramic technology rejects heat and UV rays at the particle level. It will not fade, turn purple or interfere with GPS, cell phone, radio or key-fob signals.

  • Lifetime warranty on nano ceramic film
  • Superior heat rejection for a cooler cabin and less A/C strain
  • Blocks harmful UV rays that fade and crack interiors and affect skin
  • Reduced glare for safer, more comfortable driving
  • Improved privacy and added security for your belongings
  • Holds glass together if a window is broken
  • Signal-friendly: no interference with electronics
  • Fade-resistant, long-lasting color and clarity
  • Wide range of shades, from subtle to dark
  • Precision-fit installation with clean edges and no bubbles
  • Available for cars, trucks, SUVs and dealership volume
Request Window Tint Quote

Our Process

01Consultation

We review your goals and help you choose the right shade and coverage for your style and local regulations.

02Prep

Glass is thoroughly cleaned and prepared so the film bonds flawlessly.

03Precision Install

Film is carefully cut and fitted to each window, then squeegeed for a smooth, bubble-free finish.

04Final Inspection

We inspect every window and review aftercare so your tint cures perfectly.

02 · Ceramic Coating

Ceramic Coating

Up to 5 year warranty

A professional ceramic coating creates a durable, glass-like layer of protection that bonds to your paint, keeping it deeper, glossier and easier to maintain for years.

Every coating begins with meticulous decontamination and paint preparation, because the finish is only as good as the surface beneath it.

  • Deep, mirror-like gloss and enhanced color depth
  • Strong hydrophobic properties: water, dirt and grime slide right off
  • Protection from UV rays, oxidation and fading
  • Resistance to bird droppings, bug splatter, tree sap and road film
  • Much easier and faster washing and maintenance
  • Added resistance to light swirls and wash marring
  • Long-lasting protection that outperforms waxes and sealants
  • Ideal for new vehicles, dealership inventory and daily drivers
  • Optional wheels, glass and trim coating packages
  • Up to 5 year warranty
Request Ceramic Coating Quote

Our Process

01Inspection

We evaluate the paint under specialized lighting to plan the right level of correction.

02Wash & Decontaminate

Full wash plus chemical and clay decontamination removes bonded contaminants.

03Paint Correction

Machine polishing refines the paint and removes swirls and defects before coating.

04Coating Application

Ceramic coating is applied panel by panel and leveled for a flawless finish.

05Cure & Inspect

Final inspection under lights and aftercare guidance to maximize longevity.

03 · Auto Detailing

Auto Detailing

A thorough interior and exterior detail that goes far beyond a car wash, restoring your vehicle's cleanliness, shine and comfort inside and out.

We use professional equipment, steam, machine polishers and premium products to reach the places a quick wash never will.

  • Exterior hand wash and decontamination
  • Machine polishing to restore gloss and remove light swirls
  • Interior deep cleaning: seats, carpets, mats and headliner
  • Stain and odor removal for fabric and upholstery
  • Steam cleaning for vents, engine bay and hard-to-reach areas
  • Leather and vinyl cleaning and conditioning
  • Glass cleaning inside and out
  • Trim, tire and wheel dressing
  • Engine bay cleaning
  • Final walk-around inspection before delivery
Request Detailing Quote

Our Process

01Inspection

We walk around the vehicle with you to note condition and priorities.

02Exterior Wash

Safe wash and decontamination to remove dirt and bonded contaminants.

03Interior Deep Clean

Vacuum, steam and extraction for seats, carpets and surfaces.

04Polish & Finish

Machine polishing and protection to bring back deep, clean shine.

05Final Inspection

Every detail is checked before the keys go back to you.
